sloka: पादयोः शकटं प्रादुरन्तरूर्वोरुलूखलम् ।दारुपात्राणि सर्वाणि अरणिं चोत्तरारणिम् ।दत्त्वा तु मुसलं चान्यद्यथा स्थानं विचक्षणाः ।। ६.११४.१०७ ।।
transliteration: pādayoḥ śakaṭaṁ prādurantarūrvorulūkhalam ।dārupātrāṇi sarvāṇi araṇiṁ cottarāraṇim ।dattvā tu musalaṁ cānyadyathā sthānaṁ vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.114.107 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana arranged to get excellent carts, fires maintained by Ravana, priests, so also sandalwood, and many kinds of wood, fragrant perfumes, sandals, sweet smelling odours, gems, pearls, and corals and proceeded with obsequies.
